description:
About the Organization
Now is a great time to join Redhorse Corporation. We are a solution-driven company delivering data insights and technology solutions to customers with missions critical to U.S. national interests. We’re looking for thoughtful, skilled professionals who thrive as trusted partners building technology-agnostic solutions and want to apply their talents supporting customers with difficult and important mission sets.


About the Role

Redhorse transforms the way government uses data and technology. To support this mission, we are seeking a Software Systems Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing and developing applications that contain complex logical and mathematical solutions. You will work at the intersection of hardware and software, utilizing scientific analysis and mathematical models to predict outcomes and ensure our systems meet the highest performance standards. As a mid-level professional, you will have the autonomy to determine your approach to solving difficult technical challenges that directly impact government product and commercial software utilization.

Key Responsibilities
 
 
 Conduct research in the design, development, testing, and utilization of electronic data processing software.

 Design and develop applications software and systems that integrate complex logical and mathematical solutions.

 Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, including hardware engineers and equipment designers, to plan and utilize data processing systems.

 Analyze user needs and system capabilities to resolve technical problems related to program intent, output requirements, and input data acquisition.

 Design and develop low-level system components, including compilers, assemblers, utility programs, and operating systems.

 Prepare detailed operating instructions and ensure all software standards are strictly met.

 Analyze software requirements to determine the feasibility of design within established time and cost constraints.

 Consult with systems analysts, engineers, and programmers to obtain information on project limitations, performance requirements, and interfaces.

 Apply scientific analysis and mathematical models to modify software systems and predict design consequences.

 Coordinate software system installations and monitor equipment functioning to ensure specifications and performance standards are met.

 Independently determine and develop approaches to technical solutions for a wide range of difficult problems.


 

Required Experience/Clearance
 
 Active TS/SCI clearance with FS Polygraph.

 Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) with 5+ years of experience OR a Master’s degree with 3+ years of experience.

 Demonstrated understanding of technical principles, theories, and concepts in software engineering.

 Proven experience in the design, development, and debugging of applications software.

 Experience with systems-level programming (e.g., compilers, assemblers, or operating systems).

 Strong background in using mathematical models and scientific analysis for software design.

 
Desired Experience
 
 We encourage all candidates who meet the basic requirements to apply, even if you do not have any of the following experience:

 
 Experience using GitLab for version control and Jira for project management.

 Familiarity with containerization and cloud-based data processing environments.

 Experience working in an Agile development environment.

 Knowledge of programming languages such as C, C++, or Python in a scientific or systems context.

 Prior experience supporting government or Department of Defense (DoD) software projects.


 

The salary range provided for this position represents the anticipated base salary for successful candidates. Actual compensation will be determined based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, education, certifications, skills, security clearance level, geographic location, market conditions, and internal equity. In addition to base salary, eligible employees may participate in Redhorse's comprehensive benefits programs and may be eligible for performance-based or other incentive compensation, where applicable.
 
Redhorse Corporation is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability, or any other protected class.
 
If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to access job openings or apply for a job on this site as a result of your disability. You can request reasonable accommodations by contacting Talent Acquisition at Talent-Acquisition@redhorsecorp.com
 
Redhorse Corporation shall, in its discretion, modify or adjust the position to meet Redhorse’s changing needs. This job description is not a contract and may be adjusted as deemed appropriate in Redhorse’s sole discretion.
